ITEKA RYA MINISITIRI N° 005/MoE/25
RYO KU WA 25/08/2025 RYEREKEYE
IMYUKA IHUMANYA YOHEREZWA
MU KIRERE
Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije;
Ashingiye ku Itegeko Nshinga rya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
Ashingiye ku Itegeko n° 18/2016 ryo ku wa
18/05/2016 rigenga uburyo bwo
kubungabunga ubwiza bw’umwuka no
gukumira ihumana ry’ikirere mu Rwanda,
cyane cyane mu ngingo zaryo, iya 9, iya iya
14, iya 21 n’iya 22;
Asubiye ku Iteka rya Minisitiri n° 02/2018
ryo ku wa 17/09/2018 ryerekeye imyuka
ihumanya yoherezwa mu kirere;
Inama y’Abaminisitiri yateranye ku wa
30/07/2025 imaze kubisuzuma no
kubyemeza;
ATEGETSE:

UMUTWE WA MBERE: INGINGO
RUSANGE
Ingingo ya mbere: Icyo iri teka rigamije
Iri teka rigena –
(a) uburyo n’ibisabwa kugira ngo
ibikoresho by’ubwikorezi bikoresha
ibikomoka kuri peteroli byubahirize
urugero ntarengwa rw’imyuka
ihumanya yoherezwa mu kirere;
(b) ibisabwa n’uburyo bwo gusaba,
gutanga no gukoresha uruhushya rwo
kohereza imyuka ihumanya ikirere;
(c) uburyo bwo kumenyesha ibikorwa
bihumanya ikirere uwo bireba;
(d) n’ibihano byo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi ku kutubahiriza itegeko
rigenga uburyo bwo kubungabunga
ubwiza bw’umwuka no gukumira
ihumana ry’ikirere mu Rwanda.
Ingingo ya 2: Isobanura
Muri iri teka:

(a) “Akarere” bivuga akarere gafite
ubuzimagatozi;
(b) “Ikigo” bivuga ikigo cy’Igihugu
gifite kurengera ibidukikije mu
nshingano;
(c) “uruhushya rwo kohereza imyuka
ihumanya ikirere” bivuga uruhushya
rutangwa n’Ikigo ku muntu ufite
igikorwa cyohereza imyuka ihumanya
ikirere kitubahirije amabwiriza
y’ubuziranenge agenga ubwiza
bw’umwuka.
Ingingo ya 3: Ibirebwa n’iri teka
Iri teka rireba –
(a) ubwoko bwose bw’ibikoresho
by’ubwikorezi bikoreshwa na moteri
bisohora imyuka;
(b) n’ibikorwa byemewe ariko
bitubahiriza amabwiriza
y’ubuziranenge agenga ubwiza
bw’umwuka.
UMUTWE WA II: IYUBAHIRIZWA
RY’URUGERO NTARENGWA
RW’IMYUKA IHUMANYA

YOHEREZWA MU KIRERE
Ingingo ya 4: Amabwiriza y’ubuziranenge
akurikizwa
Amabwiriza y’ubuziranenge akurikizwa ku
birebana n’urugero ntarengwa rw’imyuka
ihumanya yoherezwa mu kirere n’ibikoresho
by’ubwikorezi bikoreshwa na moteri bisohora
imyuka ashyirwaho n’urwego rwa Leta rufite
ubuzirange mu nshingano.
Ingingo ya 5: Inshingano z’utunze
cyangwa uyobora igikoresho
cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa na moteri
gisohora imyuka
Utunze cyangwa uyobora igikoresho
cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa na moteri gisohora
imyuka cyangwa ugitwara agomba gufata
neza icyo gikoresho cy’ubwikorezi
hakurikijwe uburyo bwa tekiniki bwiza
kugira ngo hubahirizwe ibipimo byemewe
by’imyuka ihumanya yoherezwa mu kirere.
Ingingo ya 6: Ibyo utunze cyangwa
ukoresha imashini ikoresha ibikomoka
kuri peteroli agomba kubahiriza
Utunze cyangwa ukoresha imashini ikoresha
ibikomoka kuri peteroli agomba kwita kuri
moteri yayo no gufata neza iyo mashini

hakurikijwe uburyo bwa tekiniki bwiza mu
rwego rwo kubahiriza urugero rwemewe
rw’imyuka ihumanya yoherezwa mu kirere.
Ingingo ya 7: Ibisabwa ku mapikipiki
atumizwa mu mahanga
(1) Ipikipiki itumizwa mu mahanga
izanywe mu Rwanda igomba kuba ari
nshya. Icyakora, bitabangamiye
ibiteganywa n’andi mategeko, Ikigo
kibisabwe, gishobora kwemera
itumizwa mu mahanga ry’ipikipiki
itari nshya, iyo yakorewe gukoreshwa
mu bya siporo cyangwa gukoreshwa
n’abantu bafite ubumuga.
(2) Nta muntu wemerewe kuzana mu
Rwanda ipikipiki ifite moteri y’ibihe
bibiri, keretse ipikipiki zigenewe
gukoreshwa mu bya siporo.
Ingingo ya 8: Ubugenzuzi bw’ibikoresho
by’ubwikorezi bikoreshwa na moteri
(1) Ikigo kigenzura ibikoresho
by’ubwikorezi bikoreshwa na moteri
bisohora imyuka, harimo amapikipiki
n’imodoka, n’izindi mashini zikoresha
ibikomoka kuri peteroli, ku bijyanye

n’isohorwa ry’imyuka ihumanya.
(2) Igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa
na moteri gisohora imyuka cyakorewe
isuzuma ry’imyuka ihumanya
kikaritsinda gihabwa icyemezo
cy’isuzuma kugira ngo cyemererwe
gukoreshwa. Icyakora, igikoresho
cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa na moteri
gisohora imyuka kitakorewe isuzuma
cyangwa cyakorewe isuzuma
ntikiritsinde cyemererwa gukoreshwa
cyangwa kugenda mu nzira
nyabagendwa iyo –
(a) igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa
na moteri kiva aho gisuzumirwa kijya
mu igaraji;
(b) igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa
na moteri kiva ahafungirwa
ibinyabiziga byakoze amakosa kijya
mu igaraji;
(c) igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa
na moteri kiva mu igaraji kigaruka
aho gisuzumirwa;
(d) igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa
na moteri cyinjiye mu Rwanda

cyarakoreshejwe mu kindi gihugu
kijyanwa aho cyambarira ibirango
by’u Rwanda cyangwa aho
kigurishirizwa;
(e) igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa
na moteri kiva aho cyambariye
ibirango bya Repubulika y’u Rwanda
kijya aho gisuzumirwa;
(f) cyangwa igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi
gikoreshwa na moteri kinyujijwe
cyangwa kiri mu Rwanda
by’agateganyo mu gihe kitarenze
amezi atatu; icyakora, iyo icyo gihe
kirenze, icyo gikoresho cy’ubwikorezi
gikoreshwa na moteri kigomba
gukorerwa isuzuma.
(3) Icyakora, igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi
gikoreshwa na moteri gisohora
imyuka gishya kitararenza imyaka
ibiri gitangiye gukoreshwa ntigisabwa
gukorerwa isuzuma ry’imyuka
ihumanya mbere y’uko icyo gihe
kirangira; icyakora iri sonerwa
ntirireba ibinyabiziga byinjizwa mu
Rwanda ariko byarakoreshejwe mu
bindi bihugu.

Ingingo ya 9: Icyemezo cy’isuzuma
(1) Ibikoresho by’ubwikorezi bikoreshwa
na moteri bikurikira bikorewe
isuzuma ry’imyuka ihumanya
bikaritsinda bihabwa icyemezo
cy’isuzuma kimara amezi atandatu:
(a) igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi
gikoreshwa na moteri kigenewe
gutwara abagenzi muri rusange;
(b) igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi
gikoreshwa na moteri kigenewe
kwikorera imizigo;
(c) ibinyabiziga byigishirizwaho
gutwara;
(d) igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi
gikoreshwa na moteri kigenewe
gukoreshwa imirimo y’ubucuruzi;
(e) ibinyabiziga bikoreshwa mu
butabazi;
(f) bisi zitwara abanyeshuri;
(g) ibikoresho by’ubwikorezi
bikoreshwa na moteri zikoresha
ibikomoka kuri peteroli

byagenewe gukoreshwa mu
bwubatsi, mu buhinzi, no mu
bindi bikorwa nk’ibyo;
(h) imbangukiragutabara.
(2) Icyemezo cy’isuzuma ku bindi byiciro
by’ibikoresho by’ubwikorezi
bikoreshwa na moteri bidateganyijwe
mu gika cya (1) kimara umwaka.
(3) Igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa
na moteri kitatsinze isuzuma
ry’imyuka ihumanya ntigihabwa
icyemezo cy’isuzuma.
(4) Iyo isuzuma rigaragaje inenge,
nyir’igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi
gikoreshwa na moteri agomba
kuzikosora kandi akakigarura
gukorerwa irindi suzuma ryemeza ko
izo nenge zakosowe mbere yo
guhabwa icyemezo cy’isuzuma.
Ingingo ya 10: Amafaranga yishyurwa ku
isuzuma
Nyir’igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa na
moteri yishyura amafaranga y’isuzuma
hashingiwe ku byiciro by’ibikoresho
by’ubwikorezi bikorerwa isuzuma nk’uko

biteganywa mu mugereka.
UMUTWE WA III: GUSABA,
GUTANGA NO GUKORESHA
URUHUSHYA RWO KOHEREZA
IMYUKA IHUMANYA IKIRERE
Ingingo ya 11: Ibisabwa mu gusaba
uruhushya rwo kohereza imyuka
ihumanya ikirere
Umuntu wifuza gukora igikorwa cyohereza
imyuka ihumanya ikirere kitubahirije
amabwiriza y’ubuziranenge agenga ubwiza
bw’umwuka, ashyikiriza Ikigo ubusabe
bwanditse bw’uruhushya rwo kohereza
imyuka ihumanya ikirere bugaragaza ibi
bikurikira:
(a) umwirondoro w’usaba;
(b) ibisobanuro ku gikorwa gihumanya
ikirere mu magambo arambuye;
(c) aho igikorwa gihumanya ikirere
gisabirwa uruhushya kizakorerwa;
(d) ubwoko n’inkomoko by’ibihumanya;
(e) impamvu zo kurenza urugero
ntarengwa rw’imyuka ihumanya
yoherezwa mu kirere;

(f) ingano y’imyuka ihumanya iteganywa
koherezwa mu kirere;
(g) ingamba zafashwe mu rwego rwo
kubika amakuru no kugenzura uko
imyuka ihumanya yoherezwa mu
kirere ingana;
(h) igihe uruhushya asaba ruzamara;
(i) andi makuru ya ngombwa yatuma
hakorwa isesengura riboneye.
Ingingo ya 12: Amafaranga atangwa mu
gusaba uruhushya
Umuntu usaba uruhushya rwo kohereza
imyuka ihumanya ikirere yishyura FRW
50.000 adasubizwa mu kigega gishinzwe
ibidukikije n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere.
Ingingo ya 13: Ibishingirwaho mu
gusuzuma ubusabe bw’uruhushya
(1) Mu kwemeza niba uruhushya rwo
kohereza imyuka ihumanya ikirere
rwatangwa, Ikigo kigomba –

(a) gushingira kuri raporo y’isuzuma
ry’ingaruka ku bidukikije
cyangwa y’ubugenzuzi
bw’ibidukikije byakozwe;
(b) gushingira ku mabwiriza
y’ubuziranenge bw’umwuka wo
mu kirere udukikije akurikizwa;
(c) gusuzuma ingaruka z’uruhurirane
ku bidukikije zishobora gukomoka
ku itangwa ry’urwo ruhushya;
(d) no kureba niba uburyo
bw’imigirire myiza kurusha iyindi
buteganyijwe bwubahirijwe.
(2) Ikigo gishobora iyo bibaye ngombwa
gusaba ko hakorwa inyigo yimbitse
yishyurwa n’usaba uruhushya, mbere
y’uko hafatwa icyemezo cya nyuma
ku busabe bw’uruhushya.
Ingingo ya 14: Gusubiza ubusabe
bw’uruhushya rwo kohereza imyuka
ihumanya ikirere
(1) Ikigo gisubiza uwasabye uruhushya
rwo kohereza imyuka ihumanya

ikirere mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 20
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi yatangiyeho
inyandiko zisabwa zose.
(2) Iyo hakenewe igihe cyo gusesengura
inyandiko isaba uruhushya kirenze
igiteganywa mu gika cya (1), Ikigo
kimenyesha uwasabye uruhushya
igihe kizatangira igisubizo.
(3) Uruhushya rwo kohereza imyuka
ihumanya ikirere rugaragaza ibisabwa
mu ikoreshwa ryarwo uwaruhawe
agomba kubahiriza.
Ingingo ya 15: Ibyo uwahawe uruhushya
agomba kubahiriza
Uwahawe uruhushya rwo kohereza imyuka
ihumanya ikirere agomba –
(a) kugenzura ku buryo buhoraho uko
kohereza imyuka ihumanya ikirere
bikorwa kandi ashyira mu bikorwa
izindi ngamba zo kugumana ubwiza
bw’umwuka n’izituma umwuka
udukikije urushaho kuba mwiza;
(b) gutegura raporo yerekana uko
igikorwa cyerekeranye n’imyuka

ihumanya ikirere cyubahiriza
ibisabwa no kuyimenyesha Ikigo mu
buryo bw’ingarukagihe;
(c) no kubahiriza ibisabwa bikubiye mu
ruhushya.
Ingingo ya 16: Igihe uruhushya rumara
Uruhushya rwo kohereza imyuka ihumanya
ikirere rumara igihe cy’imyaka ibiri ibarwa
uhereye ku itariki rwatangiweho kandi
rushobora kongererwa agaciro.
Ingingo ya 17: Gutesha agaciro uruhushya
Ikigo gitesha agaciro uruhushya rwo kohereza
imyuka ihumanya ikirere iyo –
(a) uwahawe uruhushya atubahirije
ibisabwa birebana n’ikoreshwa
ry’uruhushya rwo kohereza imyuka
ihumanya ikirere;
(b) cyangwa igikorwa cyimuriwe ahandi.
Ingingo ya 18: Imenyesha ry’ihinduka rya
nyir’igikorwa cyangwa ufite igikorwa
(1) Nyir’igikorwa cyangwa ufite igikorwa
cyatangiwe uruhushya rwo kohereza

imyuka ihumanya ikirere, amenyesha
mu nyandiko Ikigo amazina ya
nyir’igikorwa cyangwa ufite igikorwa
mushya n’aho abarizwa, mu minsi 15
ikurikira ihinduka rya nyir’icyo
gikorwa cyangwa ry’uwari ugifite.
(2) Inyandiko imenyesha igomba kuba
iherekejwe n’inyandiko igaragaza ko
nyir’igikorwa cyangwa ufite igikorwa
mushya yiyemeje kubahiriza ibisabwa
biteganyijwe mu ruhushya
rusanzweho rwo kohereza imyuka
ihumanya ikirere. Kopi y’inyandiko
imenyesha yohererezwa Umujyi wa
Kigali cyangwa Akarere bireba.
Ingingo ya 19: Ihinduka ry’igikorwa
cyohereza imyuka ihumanya
(1) Nyir’igikorwa cyangwa ufite igikorwa
wahawe uruhushya rwo kohereza
imyuka ihumanya ikirere amenyesha
Ikigo mu nyandiko ihinduka
ry’igikorwa cyohereza imyuka
ihumanya ikirere mu minsi 15
ibanziriza ihinduka ry’igikorwa.
(2) Iyo igikorwa gishya cyohereza
imyuka ihumanya ikirere irenze

urugero ntarengwa rw’imyuka
ihumanya ikirere rwemewe, nyir’icyo
gikorwa cyangwa ufite icyo gikorwa
asaba uruhushya nk’uko biteganywa
n’iri teka.
Ingingo ya 20: Amafaranga yishyurwa
kubera kohereza imyuka ihumanya ikirere
(1) Umuntu uhawe uruhushya rwo
kohereza imyuka ihumanya ikirere
yishyura buri mwaka amafaranga
ashyirwa mu kigega gishinzwe
ibidukikije n’imihindagurikire
y’ikirere.
(2) Ikigo gishyiraho kandi kigatangaza
buri mwaka ingano y’amafaranga
yishyurwa kubera kohereza mu kirere
imyuka ihumanya.
UMUTWE WA IV: KUMENYESHA
IGIKORWA GIHUMANYA IKIRERE
NO KUJURIRIRA IRYO MENYESHA
Ingingo ya 21: Imenyesha ry’igikorwa
gihumanya ikirere
(1) Umujyi wa Kigali cyangwa Akarere

gafite ubuzima gatozi bimenyesha
nyir’igikorwa mu nyandiko ko
igikorwa cye gihumanya ikirere.
(2) Inyandiko imenyesha igikorwa
gihumanya ikirere igomba kugaragaza
ibi bikurikira:
(a) ubwoko bw’ibitarubahirijwe
bimenyekanishwa;
(b) ingamba za ngombwa zo
gukumira iyoherezwa ry’imyuka
mu kirere cyangwa kubahiriza
urugero ntarengwa rw’imyuka
yoherezwa mu kirere;
(c) igihe ntarengwa ingamba zivugwa
mu gaka ka (b) zigomba kuba
zafashwe;
(d) ingengabihe y’itangwa rya raporo
z’aho ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’ingamba zafashwe rigeze.
Ingingo ya 22: Kujuririra imenyesha
(1) Umuntu wahawe inyandiko
imenyesha igikorwa gihumanya
ikirere, mu gihe cyʼiminsi ibiri
y’akazi uhereye igihe ayakiriye,
ashobora kujuririra mu nyandiko

Umujyi wa Kigali cyangwa Akarere
byayimuhaye.
(2) Umuntu wahawe inyandiko
imenyesha igikorwa gihumanya
ikirere utishimiye icyemezo
cyafashwe ku bujurire bwe, mu gihe
cyʼiminsi ibiri y’akazi amaze kubona
icyo cyemezo, ashobora kujuririra mu
nyandiko Ikigo ku bijyanye n’ingingo
zikubiye mu nyandiko imenyesha.
(3) Ikigo, kimaze gusuzuma ubujurire,
gishobora kwemeza, guhindura
cyangwa gutesha agaciro inyandiko
imenyesha igikorwa gihumanya
ikirere. Ikigo kimenyesha mu
nyandiko uwajuriye n’Umujyi wa
Kigali cyangwa Akarere icyemezo
cyacyo mu minsi 15 ikurikira itangwa
ry’ubujurire.
(4) Ujurira yishyura FRW 50.000 mu
kigega gishinzwe ibidukikije
n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere mbere yo
gutanga ubujurire. Ayo mafaranga
arayasubizwa iyo Ikigo cyemeje ko
ubujurire bwe bufite ishingiro.

Ingingo ya 23: Ibikubiye mu idosiye
y’ubujurire ku nyandiko imenyesha
igikorwa gihumanya ikirere
Idosiye y’ubujurire ku nyandiko imenyesha
igikorwa gihumanya ikirere igomba kuba
ikubiyemo ibi bikurikira:
(a) ubujurire buriho umukono;
(b) kopi y’inyandiko y’icyemezo
kijuririrwa;
(c) ikigaragaza ko amafaranga
y’ubujurire yishyuwe;
(d) indi nyandiko ya ngombwa.
UMUTWE WA V: AMAKOSA
N’IBIHANO
Ingingo ya 24: Kutubahiriza amabwiriza
yerekeye imyuka ihumanya yoherezwa mu
kirere
(1) Uretse umuyobozi w’igikoresho
cy’ubwikorezi gikoreshwa na moteri,
umuntu utubahiriza amabwiriza
yerekeye imyuka ihumanya
yoherezwa mu kirere aba akoze ikosa,

kandi ahanishwa ihazabu ya FRW
3.000.000.
(2) Nyir’igikoresho cy’ubwikorezi
gikoreshwa na moteri utubahiriza
amabwiriza yerekeye isohorwa
ry’imyuka ihumanya ikirere aba akoze
ikosa kandi ahanishwa ihazabu ya
FRW 25.000.
Ingingo ya 25: Gukora igikorwa
gihumanya ikirere nta ruhushya
Umuntu ukora, nta ruhushya, igikorwa
gihumanya ikirere kitubahirije amabwiriza
y’ubuziranenge agenga ubwiza bw’umwuka
aba akoze ikosa, kandi ahanishwa ihazabu ya
FRW 3.000.000.
Ingingo ya 26: Kutubahiriza amabwiriza
yo kubungabunga ubwiza bw’umwuka
Umuntu utubahiriza amabwiriza yerekeye
kubungabunga ubwiza bw’umwuka no
gukumira ihumanywa ry’ikirere aba akoze
ikosa, kandi ahanishwa ihazabu ya FRW
2.000.000.

Ingingo ya 27: Kutubahiriza amabwiriza
yo guhagarika ibikorwa
Umuntu utubahiriza amabwiriza yo
guhagarika ibikorwa bihumanya ikirere aba
akoze ikosa, kandi ahanishwa ihazabu ya
FRW 5.000.000.
Ingingo ya 28: Kutubahiriza amabwiriza
yo gukumira mu buryo bwihutirwa
imyuka ihumanya ikirere
Umuntu utubahiriza amabwiriza yo gukumira
imyuka ihumanya yoherezwa mu kirere mu
buryo bwihutirwa aba akoze ikosa, kandi
ahanishwa ihazabu ya FRW 3.000.000.
Ingingo ya 29: Kubangamira ubugenzuzi
Umuntu –
(a) ubangamira umugenzuzi
w’ibidukikije mu gihe ashyira mu
bikorwa inshingano ze;
(b) wangira umugenzuzi w’ibidukikije
kwinjira ku butaka cyangwa mu
nyubako agamije kugenzura;
(c) wangira umugenzuzi w’ibidukikije

kugera ku nyandiko zishyinguwe
hashingiwe ku mategeko;
(d) cyangwa uha umugenzuzi
w’ibidukikije izina, aderesi bitari byo
cyangwa amakuru ayobya;
aba akoze ikosa kandi ahanishwa ihazabu ya
FRW 500.000.
Ingingo ya 30: Kutamenyekanisha
iyoherezwa ry’imyuka ihumanya ikirere
ritagambiriwe cyangwa ridaturutse ku
bushake
Umuntu utamenyekanisha ko yohereje
imyuka ihumanya ikirere atabigambiriye
cyangwa bidaturutse ku bushake mu gihe
giteganywa n’amategeko, aba akoze ikosa,
kandi ahanishwa ihazabu ya FRW 1.000.000.
Ingingo ya 31: Ibyemezo bigamije
gusubiza mu buryo ibyangijwe
(1) Ikigo, Umujyi wa Kigali cyangwa
Akarere gafite ubuzima gatozi
bishobora gutegeka umuntu
utubahirije itegeko ryerekeye
kubungabunga ubwiza bw’umwuka
cyangwa gukumira ihumanywa

ry’ikirere –
(a) gukuraho, gusana, kugorora
cyangwa guhindura icyateye
ihumanywa ryʼikirere;
(b) cyangwa gusubiza ibidukikije
byononekaye cyangwa byangijwe
n’imyuka ihumanya uko byari
bimeze.
(2) Iyo ibiteganywa mu gika cya (1)
bidakozwe, Ikigo, Umujyi wa Kigali
cyangwa Akarere gafite ubuzima
gatozi bishobora guhagarika
by’agateganyo cyangwa burundu
igikorwa bireba.
Ingingo ya 32: Igihe cyo kwishyura
ihazabu
Umuntu wahanishijwe kwishyura ihazabu
ivugwa muri uyu mutwe, ayishyura mu
kigega gishinzwe ibidukikije
n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi irindwi uhereye igihe
yabimenyesherejwe. Iyo icyo gihe kirenze
atishyuye, yishyura amafaranga y’inyongera
angana na zero n’ibice bitanu ku ijana kuri
buri munsi w’ubukererwe.

Ingingo ya 33: Inzego zifite ububasha bwo
guca ihazabu
Ihazabu ivugwa muri iri teka icibwa n’Ikigo,
Umujyi wa Kigali cyangwa Akarere gafite
ubuzima gatozi. Icyakora, ihazabu yerekeye
imyuka yoherezwa n’ikinyabiziga
kigendeshwa na moteri icibwa na Polisi y’u
Rwanda.
UMUTWE WA VI: INGINGO
ZINYURANYE N’IZISOZA
Ingingo ya 34: Ipikipiki iri mu Rwanda mu
gihe iri teka ritangiye gukurikizwa
Ipikipiki iri mu Rwanda ku munsi iri teka
ritangiriyeho gukurikizwa ikomeza
gukoreshwa. Icyakora, igomba kubahiriza
ibiteganywa n’iri teka bijyanye n’urugero
rw’imyuka yoherezwa mu kirere yemewe.
Ingingo ya 35: Agaciro k’uruhushya
rwatanzwe mbere y’uko iri teka ritangira
gukurikizwa
Uruhushya rwo kohereza imyuka ihumanya
ikirere rwatanzwe mbere y’uko iri teka
ritangira gukurikizwa rugumana agaciro
karwo kugeza igihe rurangiriye.

Ingingo ya 36: Ingingo y’ururimi
Iri teka ryateguwe mu rurimi
rw’Ikinyarwanda.
Ingingo ya 37: Ingingo ivanaho
Iteka rya Minisitiri n° 02/2018 ryo ku wa
17/09/2018 ryerekeye imyuka ihumanya
yoherezwa mu kirere rivanyweho.
Ingingo ya 38: Gutangira gukurikizwa
Iri teka ritangira gukurikizwa ku munsi
ritangarijweho mu Igazeti ya Leta ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda.
